stories.title: Welsh Government loses first budget vote in Senedd defeat
stories.summary: The Welsh Government’s first supplementary budget has failed to pass in the Senedd, after a dispute over funding for additional learning needs left Plaid Cymru without the cross-party support it needed. stories.title: Unions react as Welsh Government confirms teachers’ pay rise below recommended 4.25%
stories.summary: Teaching unions have accused the Welsh Government of disregarding independent pay recommendations with strikes potentially looming in Flintshire and Wrexham. stories.title: Childline warns of summer spike in children seeking body image support
stories.summary: Childline is warning of a likely summer spike in children seeking support for body image concerns. stories.title: Flintshire Council seeks views on A548 Bagillt Road safety plan

stories.title: Shotton’s Dee Park Community Woodland awarded Green Flag for first time
